title: Star of India - Maritime Museum of San Diego
attribution: Scott McAvoy, University of California, San Diego Library 2020. Distributed by Open Heritage 3D.
license: CC BY (version not specified on the source record)
transformation: Potree LOD 0–3 subset; original XYZ/RGB decoded, centered, rotated from Z-up to Y-up; constant isotropic point sprites encoded as standard 32-byte SPLAT records. No learned covariance, COLMAP or 3DGS training was performed.
limitations: Visualization derivative. High-quality model without georeferencing, as classified by the publisher. Display scale is uncalibrated; not suitable for measurements or georegistration. Not associated with the local project's selected archaeological site.
